New Zealand Squad Announced for India T20 Series

New Zealand has announced a 16-member squad for a five-match Twenty20 International (T20I) series against India, scheduled to begin on October 22. Fast bowler Adam Milne and spin all-rounder Michael Bracewell have returned to the squad. All-rounder Rachin Ravindra will miss the series. The series will be played in New Zealand.
